title: Great intro to Sevilla
text: We did a customer tour of Seville. It was about 6 hours long. Communication with Maria was easy and she was very responsive. She had everything planned out and knew how best to maximize our time. The lunch recommendation in the Jewish quarter was outstanding. She is very good with a camera and took some excellent pictures of our family. I highly recommend Maria.
author: globetrotgastronome

title: Highly Recommended!
text: The private tour with Maria was very informative and entertaining. Maria responded to all of our requests and gave us lots of great information about the main attractions of Seville. We received very good tips on restaurants, shopping, events and much more. We can recommend this entertaining tour to anyone who wants to get an overview of this beautiful city at the start of their stay in Seville.
author: Trail707026

title: A perfect first day in Sevilla
text: María was fabulous. It felt like having a tour of the city with an old friend. I learned a lot, but more than anything absorbed her passion for the city. Her English is great, but I asked her to indulge my wish to practice Spanish and she was very patient!
author: KERRY C

title: Great introduction and welcome!
text: Maria Ramirez was wonderful guide. Good bits of history, lots of great ideas given for our week in Seville. Loved the Triana market tour!
author: 211lupeg

title: Smile and smile
text: Maria is super dependable and promptly responded to all my questions. Best of all she’s local and a wonderful guide. Super person!!!
author: cpphillips
